modules.name: Learn
modules.title: Backshift Rules Mastery
modules.instructions: Master tense backshift patterns (present→past, past→past perfect), modal verb changes (will→would, can→could), and exceptions for general truths.

modules.name: Write
modules.title: Tense Transformation Practice
modules.instructions: Write sentences applying correct backshift rules. Practice when to backshift vs. when to keep present tense for timeless facts.

modules.name: Play
modules.title: Tense Shift Games
modules.instructions: Play games to practice choosing correct backshifted forms. Recognize signal words that trigger tense changes.

modules.name: Apply
modules.title: Backshift Vocabulary Challenge
modules.instructions: Apply backshift markers, modal transformations, and exception indicators correctly in reported contexts.
